//: Merge these targets into apps/<expo-app>/project.json. They regenerate the committed native folders and fail when the result differs from what is committed. Run android on Linux, ios on macOS (CocoaPods): see ci-prebuild-check.yml.

commands: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- android)" || { git status --short -- android; echo 'android/ is out of date: run "npx expo prebuild --clean --platform android" and commit the result' >&2; exit 1; }
cd ios && bundle exec pod install

test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- ios)" || { git status --short -- ios; echo 'ios/ is out of date: run "npx expo prebuild --clean --platform ios" and "pod install", then commit the result' >&2; exit 1; }
